proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived matching subcritical absolute-error risk and 90%-honest connected-interval length rates in the declared masked fuzzy-RD benchmark, plus full-record converses and an all-dimensional consistency threshold. A targeted maximality revision added critical and supercritical upper brackets, while their sharpness remains unresolved; D0.5.G assessed subfield rather than the field floor and supplied no bounded improvement route. The decision audit passed and the metric citation was source-attested, but the math audit retains setup@def:model-class because smoothness on two never-observed margins is inert and unjustified; no Lean formalization was entered, and this artifact is not fully audited or an enlarged-class frontier.
tldr: For the explicitly defined fuzzy-cutoff benchmark with globally TV H\"older latent marginals, positive nuisance mixtures, and unknown shrinking compliance, the local-complier quadratic transport distance has matching minimax absolute risk and honest connected-interval length of order \(\min\{1,M^{-s/2}\}\) when \(q<2/s=4+2/\beta\), where \(M=n\kappa^{2+1/\beta}\) and \(s=\beta/(2\beta+1)\). The total observed-data construction also gives finite-sample upper envelopes \(M^{-s/2}\sqrt{\log(eM)}\) at the elbow and \(M^{-1/q}\) above it for \(M>1\), with bounded risk and length for \(M\le1\). The lower envelope remains \(\min\{1,M^{-s/2}\}\) in every dimension. Critical and supercritical sharpness remain unresolved. Uniform consistency in every fixed dimension is equivalent to \(M\to\infty\). Arbitrary atoms and exact equality are retained. A bounded joint academic and employment vector in a work-study evaluation is a prospective consumer.
gap: Scalar distributional RD inference and clean-sample transport theory leave the precision of an atomic vector local-complier distance under shrinking masked compliance uncharacterized.
fill: A total observed-data construction, an explicit global two-atom compensation family with complete record-likelihood calibration, and finite-sample honesty over the unchanged class determine one experiment-specific precision frontier.
